claim: Try the reader with sample data that stays separate from real reader data.
where: landing first action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser page opens /demo/, saves a sample cue, resets it, and asserts only the demo: localStorage namespace was used and Start for real discards it
fresh Chromium extension profile; seed 20 cues on one.example, save one on two.example, import 21 on three.example, and assert 20/1/20 per-site counts

claim: Say It Right does not send selected text or pronunciation cues to us.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; read selected text, save a cue, and assert every request remains extension-local

claim: Reads selected text with saved pronunciation cues through browser speech controls.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; seed a selected passage and cue, assert the spoken replacement, then exercise read, pause, resume, and stop

claim: Keeps the selected words visible while applying cues only to spoken output.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ page; assert the displayed sample text remains unchanged while its cue-bearing chunk exposes a different spoken value

claim: Exports a JSON backup when you request it.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; save a cue, trigger Export, parse the downloaded JSON, and record extension-local requests only

claim: Imports a portable JSON backup into the private per-site glossary.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; upload a portable JSON backup and assert the imported cue is rendered and stored only in chrome.storage.local

claim: Lets readers use the cue flow with a keyboard and visible focus.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; reach the skip link and Add cue by keyboard, then save the cue with Enter

claim: Keeps the site usable at 200% text size and with reduced motion.
sandbox: fresh 390px browser page; apply 200% root text size with reduced motion, then assert no horizontal overflow and instant scroll behavior

claim: A context-menu selection is deleted when it is expired.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; seed an 11-minute pending selection and assert storage no longer contains it after popup load

claim: This site has no advertising, tracking pixels, third-party fonts, or behavioral analytics.
sandbox: fresh browser page load; record requests and assert they are all same-origin

claim: Visitors can open the working sample reader without creating an account.
sandbox: fresh browser page clicks Try it with sample data, reaches the seeded reader, and asserts no email or password control is required

claim: Previews a cue with a voice already installed in the browser.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile with a controlled installed voice; choose that voice, preview a cue, and assert the spoken text and selected voice

claim: The installed extension reads selected text and saves cues while offline.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile switched offline before popup load; read seeded selected text, save a cue, and assert extension-local storage with no network request

claim: Opens from the Chrome toolbar, Alt+Shift+S, or the selected-text context menu.
sandbox: fresh packaged extension; assert the toolbar popup and shortcut manifest entries, the registered selection-menu entry, and the context-menu handoff that opens the cue form

claim: Uses no broad host permission and cannot access page content before an explicit reader action.
sandbox: fresh packaged extension on a normal page; assert no host permissions or content scripts, no captured page data before action, and that attempted scripting is denied without an activeTab grant

claim: Stores a private per-site pronunciation glossary in extension-local storage.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; retain one cue for one.example, save another on two.example, assert both site scopes in chrome.storage.local, and reject non-extension requests

claim: Adds, previews, edits, and deletes pronunciation cues.
sandbox: fresh Chromium extension profile; add and preview a cue, edit its spoken form, delete it, and assert extension storage after each change
